mapper.update: update Sec_Selection_Record set state = #{state} where Sr_Id = #{srId}
mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as exContrAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.*, se.* from Sec_Expert_Shield mn left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as exContrAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.*, se.* from Sec_Selection_Record_Dtl mn left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as exContrAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.*, se.* from Sec_Selection_Record_Dtl mn left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, pro.P_Professional_Type as pProfessionalType, pro.P_Professional_Type_Remark as pProfessionalTypeRemark, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Remark as secRemark, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Evaluate_Separation as secEvaluateSeparation, sec.Sec_Quali_Review as secQualiReview, sec.Sec_Bid_Time as secBidTime, sec.Sec_Loaction as secLoaction, sec.Sec_Investors_Quali as secInvestorsQuali, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Section_Classify as secSectionClassify, c1.C_Name as secTendereeName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c3.C_Name as srCompanyName, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, sbp.is_new as isNew, mn.* from Sec_Selection_Record mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id = sec.Bp_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = mn.Sr_Company where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select es.Es_Technology_Num as esTechnologyNum, es.Es_Economics_Num as esEconomicsNum, es.Es_Expert_Num as esExpertNum, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Remark as secRemark, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Evaluate_Separation as secEvaluateSeparation, sec.Sec_Quali_Review as secQualiReview, sec.Sec_Bid_Time as secBidTime, sec.Sec_Loaction as secLoaction, sec.Sec_Investors_Quali as secInvestorsQuali, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sd.D_Function as dFunction, sd.D_Scope as dScope, sd.D_Executive_Standard as dExecutiveStandard, sd.D_Amount as dAmount, sd.D_Bid_Time as dBidTime, sd.D_Location as dLocation, c1.C_Name as secTendereeName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c3.C_Name as esCompanyName, mn.state as srState, es.state as esState, es.*, mn.* from Sec_Selection_Record mn left join Sec_Expert_Select es on es.id = mn.Es_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = es.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = es.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = es.Es_Company left join Sec_Document sd on sd.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id and sd.D_State = 7 where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select es.Es_Technology_Num as esTechnologyNum, es.Es_Economics_Num as esEconomicsNum, es.Es_Expert_Num as esExpertNum, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Remark as secRemark, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Evaluate_Separation as secEvaluateSeparation, sec.Sec_Quali_Review as secQualiReview, sec.Sec_Bid_Time as secBidTime, sec.Sec_Loaction as secLoaction, sec.Sec_Investors_Quali as secInvestorsQuali, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sd.D_Function as dFunction, sd.D_Scope as dScope, sd.D_Executive_Standard as dExecutiveStandard, sd.D_Amount as dAmount, sd.D_Bid_Time as dBidTime, sd.D_Location as dLocation, c1.C_Name as secTendereeName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c3.C_Name as esCompanyName, mn.state as srState, es.*, mn.* from Sec_Selection_Record mn left join Sec_Expert_Select es on es.id = mn.Es_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = es.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = es.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = es.Es_Company left join Sec_Document sd on sd.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id and sd.D_State = 7 where mn.Es_Id = #{esId} order by mn.Sr_Create_Time desc limit 1

select distinct ${selectClause} from Sec_Selection_Record mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id = sec.Bp_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = mn.Sr_Company left join SYS_Department d on d.D_Id = pro.p_Competent_Department ${params.authSql}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sec_Document t WHERE t.d_state = 7 and t.sec_id = #{secId} and t.d_id in (select sf.fileId from sys_file sf where (sf.t_code = #{templateCode} or sf.t_code = #{fileTemplateCodeNew}) and sf.fileFlowStatus = 7)
select C_Id from Sec_Invitation_Schema_Dtl where Is_Id = #{invitationSchemaId} order by Sort asc
